01 · Professional profile

Accounting knowledge with
real-world relevance.

About me

Accounting academic at Universiti Tenaga Nasional (UNITEN) with experience in higher education, departmental leadership, collaborative research and academic programme development. Research and scholarly contributions span taxation and tax compliance, whistleblowing, corporate governance, green government procurement, sustainability, accounting systems and corporate risk reporting.

My professional approach

Connecting accounting and financial knowledge with practical learning, authentic assessment and community engagement. I value teaching that links academic concepts with applied problems and professional practice.

04 · Research

Research interests

A cross-disciplinary focus on accountability, responsible practice and the use of accounting information.

AREA 01

Taxation & tax compliance

Tax literacy, tax relief and deductions, compliance costs, tax administration and tax investment incentives.

AREA 02

Whistleblowing & ethics

Whistleblowing intention among future accountants, external auditors and government auditors, including protection frameworks.

AREA 03

Corporate governance

Transparency, governance indicators, board characteristics and board meeting frequency.

AREA 04

Green government procurement

Indicators, determinants and implementation practices in Malaysian public enterprises.

AREA 05

Sustainability & environmental incentives

Tax investment incentives related to environmental protection activities.

AREA 06

Accounting systems & digital reporting

Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), big data readiness and corporate internet risk reporting.

05 · Selected work

Projects & contributions

Selected academic and collaborative work from the supplied CV and related academic profile information.

COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT

Bijak Taksir Zakat (BTZ)

Practice-oriented zakat learning and certification initiative involving UNITEN, Pusat Kutipan Zakat Pahang and higher-education partners. Includes business-zakat assessment and practical calculation using financial statements.

ETHICS & ACCOUNTABILITY

Whistleblowing research

Scholarly work on whistleblowing intention among future accountants, external auditors and government auditors, alongside research discussions on protection under Malaysia’s Whistleblower Protection Act 2010.

SUSTAINABILITY

Green Government Procurement

Collaborative research on indicators, determinants and practices associated with green government procurement in Malaysian public enterprises.

TAXATION

Tax literacy & compliance

Research contributions on taxpayer knowledge, tax relief and deductions, tax compliance costs, tax administration and tax investment incentives.

INNOVATION & REPORTING

Corporate Internet Risk Reporting Index (CIRRI)

Collaborative work presented through poster exhibitions and innovation or symposium activities, as listed in the academic profile.
